item.title: Studying or doing a doctorate with care responsibilities?
item.description:
Studying or doing a doctorate with care responsibilities?

The Prof. Sorin Huss Fund supports students and doctoral candidates at TU Darmstadt who care for minor children or relatives in need of care. It covers childcare costs, study fees for the final two semesters, or a student assistant for doctoral candidates.

Applications are open until 15 November 2026. Please send your application to servicestelle-familie@zv.tu-darmstadt.de.

ISS is sharing this on behalf of the organizers. For more details or any questions, please reach out directly to the contact listed on the slides.

Your career path starts long before graduation!

International Career Service Rhein-Main offers free career advising in German and English, mentoring, CV checks and workshops. The advising is especially for international students and students with a migration background, and the workshops are open to everyone.

Scan the QR code on the graphic to register, or find them on Instagram at @ics_rm.

item.title: German Unity Day – Saturday, 3 October 2026
item.description:
German Unity Day – Saturday, 3 October 2026

Tag der Deutschen Einheit is Germany's national day. It marks the moment in 1990 when East and West Germany formally reunified into a single country after decades of division, one of the most significant dates on the German calendar. It's also a nationwide public holiday.

Since it falls on a Saturday this year, closing rules apply, meaning grocery stores and most shops will be closed all day.

Stock up on groceries and anything else you need by Friday!
